title: The robot ladder's bottom two rungs: the mark-1 arrives when the work has been felt, the mark-2 once a mark-1 has been used
tier_reason: S-12 landed the top two rungs (bench, Mark III) on a ladder whose bottom two, ruled on 2026-09-04 under Q-88, were never built: today the mark-1 and the mark-2 are plain purchases with nothing but price between them, so a player can buy a reacting machine before ever using a pre-programmed one.
first_action: Read Q-88's ruling in docs/DECISION_LOG.md and docs/design/06 'The rungs themselves' for what 'the work has been felt' and 'used a mark-1' mean in world terms, then add the two rungs to SimWorld.rungs beside RUNG_MK2_WORKED and RUNG_DESK_PLACED with earned_by/earns rows in systems/machine_defs.gd.
ask: Found while building S-12 (w1a08ee15304): the brief assumed the mark-2's Q-88 gate lived in the sim, and it does not. Build the bottom two rungs with the same machinery S-12 used: two latched rung facts on the world (SimWorld.rungs, written by the gateway at the moment the proof happens, saved with the world, survive replay), read by SimWorld.offers so the shelf and the till ask one question. Define the proofs from Q-88 and design/06 — the mark-1 offered once the farming work has been felt (pick the world fact that means that; the tally mechanism MachineDefs.is_unlocked already reads harvest counts and may be the right shape), the mark-2 offered once a mark-1 of hers has completed a job. Unit tests: neither rung is offered early, each is offered the moment its condition holds, an older save is read sensibly. Keep the robot session and the integration scenarios staging the rungs they need (they already call sim.earn for the top two). Update the shop's [Playtest] comments for both rows. Do not touch the learner.
source_message: Filed by the chief of staff from Tomas's S-12 report, 2026-09-10.
